create_SawtoothModels: create a SawtoothModels container with trigger and redistribution models for JAX static arguments
build_TriggerModel: build a TriggerModel subclass that determines if a sawtooth crash is triggered and returns the q=1 surface radius
build_RedistributionModel: build a RedistributionModel subclass that redistributes core profiles after a sawtooth crash
test_TriggerConfig: test the TriggerConfig pydantic model that configures sawtooth trigger parameters like minimum_radius
test_RedistributionConfig: test the RedistributionConfig pydantic model that configures sawtooth redistribution parameters like flattening_factor
